blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Handwritten text recognition (HTR) for the registers of Pope Honorius III depends on modern expert transcriptions, which exist only for regnal years 1-2 of Reg. Vat. 9. For the remaining registers, nineteenth-century scholarship offers Pressutti's regesta and partial editions. On fol. 1-203, where both layers exist, we measure what this legacy layer can contribute, on transcriptions that we first audit against it, and find a division of labor across three tiers. At the orthographic tier, raw editions are at best neutral for adapting a recognizer to the second regnal year and harmful without replay, whereas projection onto curial spelling with replay of modern source lines turns them into zero-label adaptation targets: pooled over all 134 year-2 sides, the WER falls by 1.50 points (95% CI -1.84 to -1.15), closing 33% of the gap to an oracle; the spelling changes at the year split, through the scribe or the transcriber, whereas the hand changes visibly only at fol. 191r. At the lexical tier, the corpus-wide legacy lexicon contains 82.2% of the out-of-vocabulary words of unedited entries and flags recognition errors with 66.7% precision, and labels from pre-trained medieval NER models, distilled into the recognizer's NER head, reach F1 82.1% on an expert validated benchmark, level with the best tagger applied after recognition. At the topological tier, Pressutti's regests, the closing datum clauses, and the regests' dates converted to the chancery's Roman form find 73.9% of entry starts in the recognized line stream, and edition agreement estimates a CER of 7.80% beyond fol. 203. Antiquarian scholarship thus cannot replace modern transcription, but it can steer, check, and segment HTR across the untranscribed registers.
blocks.zh: 手写文字识别(HTR)用于教宗荣誉三世的注册,取决于现代专家的抄录,这些抄录只存在于Reg. Vat的正统年份1-2. 9. 对于其余的登记册,19世纪的奖学金提供Pressutti的regesta和部分版本。 在1-203分上,如果两层都存在,我们衡量这个遗留层能起到什么作用,我们首先对它进行审核,并找出分出三个层次的劳动分工。 在正文层次上,原始版本充其量是中立的,可以使识别器适应第二个正文年份,而且有害而不重放,而投射到带有现代源行重放的曲式拼写上则使其变为零标签的适应目标:在所有134年到2年的平面上集合,WER下降1.50分(95% CI -1.84至-1.15分),将差距的33%缩小为甲骨文;当年的拼写变化通过文人或转写方式分出,而手只以活字191r的速度明显地改变。 在词典层面,全体遗留的词典包含有未经编辑的条目和旗帜识别错误的82.2%,精度为66.7%,以及来自经过预先培训的中世纪NER模型的标签,分馏入识别器的NER头,在专家验证的基准上达到F1 82.1%,在识别后应用了最好的标记器. 在地貌层面,Pressutti的Regests,收尾基准条款,以及Regests转换为atterial's Roman形式的日期,发现73.9%的入段开始于公认的行流,版协议估计排减量为7.80%出自fol. 203. 因此,古老的奖学金不能取代现代的抄录,但可以指导、检查和分解未登记登记册。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The registers of Honorius III (Reg. Vat. 9–13) hold more than 5,000 letters and have no modern edition. A forced-aligned recognizer trained on the expert transcriptions of the first two regnal years reads held-out pages of the same volume with 12.5% WER, and with 8.7% WER after re-alignment, bidirectional decoding with BPE targets, and language-model rescoring ( Kovács and Luger, 2026 ) . These transcriptions end at fol. 203 of Reg. Vat. 9. For the remaining folios, two older kinds of text exist: the regesta of Pressutti (1888) ; Pressutti (1895) , which record for nearly every entry its folio, letter number, a Latin summary, and the incipit, and full texts printed in the nineteenth century, above all in Horoy’s Opera omnia ( Horoy, 1879–1882 ) , but also in the MGH selection of Rodenberg (1883) , in Raynaldi’s Annales ecclesiastici ( Raynaldi, 1864–1883 ) , and in Theiner’s regional collections ( Theiner, 1859–1860 ; Theiner, 1860 ; Theiner, 1861 ; Theiner, 1863 ; Theiner, 1864 ) . These texts were made for reading: they modernize spelling, abridge formulae, and expand initials, and their OCR adds its own noise.
blocks.zh: Honorius III (Reg. Vat. 9-13)的登记册有5000多封信,没有现代版本。 一个接受过前两年专家笔录培训的强迫校对者阅读了同卷中12.5%的WER和8.7%的WER,与BPE目标进行双向解码,以及语言模型重评(Kovács和Luger,2026年)。 这些抄本都写在纸上 (原始内容存档于2017-03-29). Reg. Vat. 203 of Reg. 9. 对于其余的文字,有两种较古老的文字:Pressutti的文字(1888年);Pressutti的文字(1895年),几乎每条文字都记录其文字、字母编号、拉丁文摘要和印记,以及19世纪印刷的全文,首先是Horoy的Opera omnia(Horoy,1879–1882年),还有Rodenberg的MGH选集(1883年),Raynaldi的Annales ecclesisistici(Raynaldi,1864–1883年),以及Theiner的区域藏书(Theiner,1859–1860年;Theiner,1859–1860年)。 1860年;蒂纳, 1861年; 蒂纳, 1863 ; Theiner, 1864 ). . 这些文本是用来阅读的:它们使拼写,桥式公式现代化,并扩展首字母,它们的OCR增加了自己的噪音.

blocks.en: Aligning images with existing editions is an established way to obtain ground truth for registers and charters ( Stutzmann et al., 2017 ; Bluche et al., 2017 ; Torres Aguilar and Jolivet, 2023 ) , and models trained on such data reproduce the editorial conventions of their targets ( Torres Aguilar and Jolivet, 2023 ; Kovács and Luger, 2026 ) ; earlier work on the papal registers used crowd-sourced or expert line transcriptions ( Nieddu et al., 2021 ; Ammirati et al., 2023 ) . What has not been measured is how far antiquarian editions of a register stand from a modern transcription of the same letters, and what that distance costs a recognizer.
blocks.zh: 将图像与现有版本相统一是获取注册和章程基本真相的既定方式(Stutzmann等人,2017年;Bluche等人,2017年;Torres Aguilar和Jolivet,2023年),并且就这些数据接受过培训的模型复制了目标编辑惯例(Torres Aguilar和Jolivet,2023年;Kovács和Luger,2026年);早期关于教宗登记册的工作使用了众包或专家行记录(Nieddu等人,2021年;Ammirati等人,2023年)。 还没有测量到的是,一个寄存器的古老版本 与同一字母的现代转录相距有多远, 以及那段距离要花费一个识别器。

blocks.en: Reg. Vat. 9, fol. 1–203, carries both the modern transcriptions and this legacy layer, so the legacy route can be measured against modern ground truth before it is used where no such truth exists. We address three research questions. RQ1 (orthographic tier): how accurately can nineteenth-century editions be force-aligned to recognized lines and projected onto the spelling of the register, and how much of the gap to the second regnal year do they close when a recognizer is adapted without modern labels (Sections 3–5)? RQ2 (lexical tier): how much of the out-of-vocabulary words and proper names of unseen pages do the regesta and editions cover, and can pre-trained medieval NER models together with this legacy lexicon reduce name errors and supervise a recognizer’s NER head without a hand-written rule (Section 7)? RQ3 (topological tier): on folios without an edition, how well can Pressutti’s regesta segment the recognized line stream into entries, and how far can edition agreement estimate recognition quality beyond fol. 203 (Sections 5–6)? Our answer is a division of labor: modern transcriptions train the recognizer, while the legacy layer adapts it, checks its vocabulary, and structures its output.
blocks.zh: Vat. 9, fol. 1–203号法规既载有现代的抄本,也载有这一遗留层,因此,在没有这种真实性的地方使用之前,可以参照现代地面真理来衡量遗留的路径。 我们处理三个研究问题。 RQ1(正字级):十九世纪的版本能在多大程度上与识别的线条对齐并投射到寄存器的拼写上,当一个识别器在没有现代标签的情况下进行改造时(第3至5节),它们有多少缺口会关闭到第二个肾上腺年? RQ2(语法等级):regesta和版面所覆盖的省外词和隐形页的正确名称是多少,并且可以预先训练的中世纪NER模型与这个遗留的词典一起减少名称错误,并监督一个识别器的NER头没有手写规则(第7节)? RQ3( 地形等级): 在没有版本的光圈上, Pressutti 的 regesta 段能有多好, 203(第5-6节)? 我们的答案是分工:现代的抄本训练识别器,而遗留层则改造它,检查它的词汇,构建它的输出.

blocks.en: 2 Data, Recognizers, and Legacy Sources
blocks.zh: 2 数据、识别器和遗产来源

blocks.en:
We use the 394 pages of Reg. Vat. 9 (fol. 1–130 and 137–203) with the expert transcriptions of 860 entries (203,819 words) by D. Luger (year 1) and A. Singh Bottanova (first half of year 2); every tenth page is a test page and every tenth a development page, giving 315 training, 40 development, and 39 test pages and 13,122 modern silver lines obtained by forced alignment (10,525 training, 1,313 development, and 1,284 test lines). The recognizers are those of Kovács and Luger (2026) : (1) C, an eight-block Conformer-CTC encoder (12.5 M parameters, d = 256 d=256 , a four-block convolutional front-end on 64-pixel lines) whose padding masks pass through every convolution, pooling, and batch-normalization layer, so that decoding does not depend on the inference batch; (2) the hybrid, which adds a four-layer Transformer attention decoder (0.3 CTC + + 0.7 cross-entropy, 16.8 M parameters) and a linear token-level NER head ( + + 0.5 NER loss); and (3) the R2L-BPE hybrid, which extends the hybrid with a right-to-left decoder over BPE-512 targets and Kneser–Ney language-model rescoring of its 16-best lists. An automatic audit of the transcriptions flags 419 of the 84,660 words of lines that also have an edition target where the projected edition and an out-of-fold HTR reading agree with each other against the transcription; 355 words (0.42%), on which the two witnesses agree letter for letter, are corrected, and all experiments use the audited text. The audit draws on the editions themselves, but it leaves the headline adaptation estimate of Section 5 essentially unchanged ( − - 1.46 WER points on the original transcriptions, − - 1.50 on the audited ones). The authors judged a random sample of 100 corrections: 75 are right, 10 are not justified (medieval spellings the edition normalized, word-boundary artifacts, an edition misprint), and 15 cannot be decided without the manuscript (88% of the decidable, 95% CI 80–93%); rules derived from these cases reduce the audit to 322 corrections for future work.
Recognized lines are segmented by Kraken and first read by CATMuS Medieval 1.5; error rates compare the reading layer of recognizer and expert text (u/v, i/j, ae/e, ti/ci harmonized), with words aligned per line.

blocks.en:
The OCR of both volumes (Internet Archive) is parsed into 5,059 entries with number, date and place, register reference (book, letter, folio), incipit, and edition citations; the appendix of incoming letters (41 Lettere de’ Principi ) forms a separate list. Through Pressutti’s number, which the expert transcriptions record, 626 of the 860 transcribed entries are linked to their regest, and Pressutti cites Horoy for 267 of them.
Before parsing, the OCR is normalized (one pair of quote marks, re-joined hyphens, running heads removed), and the register references are read in both orders of folio and letter: this recovers the address of 3,845 regests (only 1 before normalization, because the parser needs two quoted units and the OCR renders the quote marks in many forms) and the letter number of 3,928 (3,830 before), and 129 OCR digit confusions are repaired where they break the register’s order. Of Pressutti’s 5,059 regests, 46.7% name no printed edition (an upper bound, since Pressutti’s citations are incomplete) (book 1: 27.1%, book 11: 65.4%), which is the share of letters for which only the regest exists.

在解析前,OCR是正常化的(一对引号,复联连字符,运行头被移除),寄存器的引用用folio和字母的顺序来读:这恢复了3,845个登记器的地址(在正常化前只有1个,因为寄存器需要两个引号单位,而OCR以多种形式使寄存器的引用标记)和3,928个字母(前3,830个),129个OCR数字混淆被修复到它们打破寄存器顺序的地方. 在Pressutti的5,059个注册商中,46.7%没有印刷版(上限,因为Pressutti的引用不完整)(第1册:27.1%,第11册:65.4%),这是只有注册商的字母份额。

blocks.en: Horoy’s letter numbers do not follow the register numbering of the transcriptions, so we link by text. Every text is reduced to a matching layer (lower case, letters only; j → \to i, v → \to u, y → \to i, ae/oe/æ/œ → \to e, ti + + vowel → \to ci , ch → \to h with h dropped, so that mihi and michi coincide). Three 120-character windows of each transcribed entry are searched in the full OCR text of eleven volumes, and an entry is linked when two windows match in order at a normalized distance of at most 0.25, or one at most 0.12. This links 509 entries (59%; years 1 and 2: 360 and 149; Table 1 ) and recovers 249 of the 267 entries for which Pressutti cites Horoy. For 358 entries (91,505 expert words), the edition span lies within distance 0.30 of the expert text; most of the remainder are correct letters whose spans are interrupted by running heads and footnotes at page breaks (the OCR reads Horoy’s two columns in the right order).
blocks.zh: Horoy的字母号码没有跟随记录的号码, 每个文本都简化为匹配层(下个大小写,只有字母;j →\to i, v →\to u, y →\to i, ae/oe/æ/ → → e, ti + + 元音 + ci, ch → h 与 h dropp, 这样 mihi 和 michi 重合). 每个转录条目的3个120字符窗口在11卷的完整OCR文本中进行搜索,当两个窗口相匹配时将一个条目链接起来,其顺序为常态距离最多0.25,或最多0.12. 这链接了509个条目(59%;第1和2年:360和149;表1),并收回了Pressutti引用Horoy的267个条目中的249个。 358个条目(91,505个专家字)的版面跨度在专家文本的0.30个距离之内;其余大部分是正确字母,其跨度因在分页处运行头部和脚注而中断(OCR按正确的顺序读Horoy的两列).

blocks.zh: 3 与第十九批文本对齐

Placed: the nineteenth-century target lies within reading-layer distance 0.35 of the modern target of the same line. blocks.en: The CATMuS reading of each line is aligned to the edition spans of the entries on its folio and the neighbors. We compare the baseline semi-global aligner of Kovács and Luger (2026) (edit distance with re-anchoring; accepted at distance ≤ \leq 0.35, silver at ≤ \leq 0.25 and ≥ \geq 15 characters) with two additions. Entry anchoring assigns lines in reading order to non-decreasing entries, or to none (marginalia, rubrics, entries without edition), by a monotone Viterbi pass over the per-entry distances, with a bonus where a line contains the entry’s incipit. Formula bridging inserts after every etc. the majority continuation of its three preceding words in the Innocent III edition, and each line uses the better of the plain and the bridged text. Curial projection maps the target to the spelling of the register: ae/oe → \to e and j → \to i always, ti → \to ci and mihi → \to michi where the reader shows the curial form, and optionally a bare initial of the reader for an expanded name.
blocks.zh: CATMuS对每行的读数都与其folio和邻居的条目的版本跨度一致。 我们比较了Kovács和Luger的基线半全球对齐器(2026年)(编辑距离与重新沉淀;在距离上接受 \ leq 0.35,银色为 \ leq 0.25 和\\ geq 15 字符)和两个加法。 输入锚定通过单音Viterbi通过每次输入的距离,在读取时将线条指定为非减速条目,或无(marginalia, rubrics, 条目无版), 并附带一个包含条目内插的线条。 公式连接插入到每个等值之后。 在Innocent III版中,大多数前三个词的继续,每行都使用平面文字和桥面文字。 Curial project将目标映射到寄存器的拼写:ae/oe →\e和j –我总是,ti →\ci和mihi →\michi,读者在那里显示曲目形式,并可以选择一个读者的赤裸的首字母来扩展名称.

blocks.en: The legacy texts give 5,446 silver lines from the strict links and 6,156 from all links, about half of the 13,122 lines that the modern transcriptions give on the same pages (Table 3 ), and 98.9% of them are placed on the same text as the modern target. The remaining differences are editorial rather than positional: 3.40% CER on the reading layer, 3.86% on the strict layer, and 12.5% WER, which curial projection lowers to 3.13%, 3.21%, and 10.8%. Anchoring adds few lines (5,472 against 5,446) at slightly lower fidelity, and bridging applies to 10 lines only, because the register itself abridges most formulae. Placement is therefore solved by the baseline aligner. Projection removes the spelling of the classicizing Horoy edition (3.45% → \to 3.12% CER for its lines) and leaves the MGH, Raynaldi, and Theiner lines unchanged. What remains after projection is mostly not spelling: edition emendations and abridgements account for 41% of the residual edits, OCR noise for 28%, and words cut at line edges by the alignment for 22%, whereas curial variants that projection does not model (numerals, eandem , doubled consonants) account for 7.8%, none of them for more than 3%; projecting all of them as well would lower the reading-layer CER only from 3.32% to 3.30% (on the 5,205 strict-link line pairs where both projections can be compared). Curial projection is thus close to its ceiling. The rules need not be written by hand. Learned from the 3,171 silver lines of the year-1 training pages alone (character rewrites with one character of left and up to two of right context, read off the aligned word pairs and kept when they make at least 15 more correct than wrong changes), 46 rules with 11 distinct rewrites recover j → \to i, æ/ae → \to e and mihi → \to michi , add three curial variants that the hand rules leave out ( quemdam → \to quendam , quum → \to cum , xs → \to x) and four OCR confusions of the editions (fl → \to fi among them), and do not learn ti → \to ci, because the modern transcriptions keep ti before a vowel (1,793 of 1,881 aligned cases in year 1). On the held-out year-1 pages they lower the strict-layer CER to 3.38% against 3.56% for the hand rules, and on year 2, transcribed by the other expert, to 3.34% against 3.53% (Table 4 ); gating the less certain rules by the reader, as the hand rules gate ti/ci, changes little. Curial projection is thus a procedure that can be estimated from a few hundred paired lines, not a rule list tied to this register. The experiments below use the hand rules; the learned rules are a later check, and since they also lower the reading-layer CER (by 0.15–0.18 points), the experiments are, if anything, conservative.
blocks.zh: 遗留的文本从严格的链接中给出了5,446条银线,从所有链接中给出了6,156条银线,大约是现代抄本在同一页上给出的13,122条银线的一半(表3),98.9%的银线与现代目标放在同一个文本上. 其余的差别是编辑性而不是位置性:读取层为3.40%的CER,严格层为3.86%,而WER为12.5%,居心投影率降至3.13%,3.21%和10.8%. 安乔林在略低的忠诚度下增加了几行(5,472对5,446),桥接仅适用于10行,因为寄存器本身是大多数公式的桥接. 因此,定位由基准对齐器解决。 投影取消了经典的Horoy版的拼写(3.45%~\=3.12% CER的行),使MGH,Raynaldi和Theiner的行不变. 投影后剩下的大部分不是拼写:版面模版和缩写占剩余编辑的41%,OCR噪声占28%,线边的词被对齐切除占22%,而投影不模型(数字,eandem,双倍对齐)的曲面变体占7.8%,其中无一超过3%;投影全部的读数层CER只从3.32%降至3.30 %(在可比较两个预测的5,205个严格连接线对上). 因此,好奇预测接近其上限。 规则不需要手写. 仅从1年1月1日的3 171个银行学习(字形重写,左侧字符最多2个右上下文,读出对齐的单词对,当它们至少比错误的修改更正确15个时保留),46个规则,有11个不同的重写恢复j → i,æ/ae → e 和 mihi → → michi ,加上三个曲式变体,手规则省出(quemdam → to quendam ,quum → →to cum, xs → → →to x)和4个OCR 混淆版本(fl → → o fo ),没有学到 → → ci,因为现代曲式保留到元音(1年1 881个对齐案例中的 1 793个). 在被搁置的第一年,他们将严格的CER降低到3.38%,而手规则则降低到3.56%;第二年,由另一位专家转录到3.34%,而3.53%(表4);读者对不太明确的规则表示不满,因为手规则的门为ti/ci,变化不大。 因此,Curial Project是一种可以从几百对线上估算的程序,而不是一个与这个寄存器捆绑的规则列表. 下面的实验使用手规则;学到的规则是后来的检查,由于它们也降低了读取层CER(0.15–0.18分),所以实验即使有什么,也是保守的.

blocks.en: Legacy lines alone yield a usable but clearly weaker recognizer (Table 5 ): the hybrid reaches 20.1% WER on projected and 23.3% on raw lines, C 23.6% and 26.9%. Projection improves the hybrid by 3.2 and C by 3.4 points, and a small modern seed adds 2.0 more (18.1% for the hybrid). With as many modern lines the hybrid reaches 14.5%, so the editorial divergence of the targets costs more (20.1% against 14.5%) than halving the modern data. Clause-final words suffer most (24–35% WER), where the editions abridge closing formulae.

blocks.en:
The source model reads year 2 with 18.7% WER and 9.09% CER (Table 6 ). Projected legacy lines with replay lower these to 16.0% and 7.37%, a paired bootstrap difference of − - 2.8 WER points (95% CI − - 3.6 to − - 1.8) and − - 1.7 CER points (paired page bootstrap, 10,000 resamples), against 12.6% with modern year-2 lines; this is the best of three training seeds ( − - 3.1, − - 2.8, and − - 2.6 points; mean − - 2.8). Since 13 pages are a small sample, we repeat the experiment as three-fold cross-validation over the 67 year-2 folios, adapting on the legacy lines of the other folds’ sides and scoring all sides of the held-out fold. Pooled over 134 sides, the WER falls from 17.0% to 15.5% ( − - 1.50 points, 95% CI − - 1.84 to − - 1.15; CER − - 0.89), against 12.5% for the oracle, so the legacy lines close 33% of the gap; this is the estimate we rely on. The gain is the same where only the transcriber changes (fol. 137–190, 108 sides: − - 1.45 points, 95% CI − - 1.84 to − - 1.04) and where the hand changes as well (fol. 191–203, 26 sides: − - 1.70, CI − - 2.32 to − - 1.07), against oracle gains of − - 4.19 and − - 5.82 points: the legacy lines adapt the model to what the two segments share, the year-2 spelling of scribe or transcriber, and the new hand adds no measurable gain of its own, while the modern labels gain more there. Without replay, raw legacy lines raise the pooled WER ( + + 2.2 points in the cross-validation) and the model forgets year 1 ( + + 3.9 points on the 13 pages); with replay they help a little (17.3%, − - 1.5 points, 95% CI − - 2.6 to − - 0.3), and projection adds more. The edition families show why: raw lines of the classicizing Horoy edition worsen the year-2 WER ( + + 0.7 points), its projected lines improve it ( − - 2.2), and the raw lines of the MGH and Theiner editions, which keep the register’s spelling, help even unprojected ( − - 0.5 and − - 0.8). Replaying year-1 legacy instead of modern lines gives almost the same year-2 gain here ( − - 2.7) but does not prevent forgetting (year-1 WER 13.5% against 11.6%); with the original transcription legacy replay gained less, so whether the modern replay labels add to the year-2 gain remains open.
Tagging each target with its convention instead of projecting it (a token <mod> or <horoy> etc. before the decoder targets, CTC on the reading layer) reaches 17.1% WER on raw tagged lines (17.0% with modern replay; 16.2% when the tag also conditions the decoder layers by FiLM), against 16.0% for projection with replay. The tag does not steer the decoder in any variant (CER against the raw edition text 10.8% with the edition tag and 10.7% with <mod> ; 10.6% and 10.7% with FiLM), so it cannot select the convention of the output, which the projection rules fix explicitly.
Clause-final words remain the weak point (20.5% WER against 14.6% for the oracle). Projection and replay together make the legacy layer a zero-label adaptation signal worth about a third of the oracle gap, once some forty edited folios are available.
blocks.zh:
源模型读作第2年,WER占18.7%,CER占9.09%(表6)。 预计遗留线的重播率将降至16.0%和7.37%,对双靴子的差值为−2.8WER点(95%CI−3.6至−1.8)和−1.7CER点(页靴子,10,000复标),而现代2号线为12.6%;这是三种训练种子中最好的(−-3.1、−2.8和−2.6点;平均值−-2.8)。 由于13页是一个小样本,我们重复了这个实验,作为67年2月的3倍交叉验证,在其它折叠面的遗留线上进行调整,并在被搁置折叠面的方方面面打分。 超过134个方面,WER从17.0%下降到15.5%(−1.50分,95%CI−1.84分下降到−1.15分;CER−0.89分),而甲骨文为12.5%,因此遗留线接近33%的差距;这是我们所依赖的估计值。 收益与只有转写变化(fol.137–190,108侧:−-1.45分,95%CI−1.84至−1.04)和手部也有变化(fol.191–203,26侧:−-1.70,CI−2.32至−1.07)的情况相同,与甲骨文收益(−4.19和−5.82分)相对照:遗产线使模型适应两个部分共用的东西,书写或转写年份的拼写,新手没有增加自己的可计量收益,而现代标签在那里获得更多收益. 不重播,原始遗存线提高集合WER(++ 2.2分在交叉验证中),模型忘记了第1年(++3.9分在13页);通过重播,它们帮助了一点(17.3%,−-1.5分,95%CI−---0.3),投影增加了更多. 这些版本的家庭显示了为什么:经典化的Horoy版的原始线恶化了2年WER(++0.7分),其预测线条改善了它(− - 2.2),MGH版和Theiner版的原始线条保持了寄存器的拼写功能,帮助甚至没有预测(− - 0.5和− - 0.8). 重播第1年的遗产,而不是现代的线条,给这里几乎同一年的2年增益(−−−2.7),但并不能阻止忘记(第1年的WER 13.5%对11.6%);原抄本的遗产重播所得较少,所以现代的重播标签是否增加了第2年增益,仍然开放.
将每个目标与公约挂钩,而不是投影(一个符号“mod”或“horoy”) 在解码器目标之前,读取层的CTC)在原始标记线上达到17.1%的WER(17.0%与现代重播;当标记还给FiLM的解码层设置条件时达到16.2%),而用重播进行投影时达到16.0%. 该标签不引导任何变体中的解码器(CER与原版文本的10.8%与版标签的10.7%,与"mod"的10.7%;与FiLM的10.6%和10.7%),因此它不能选择输出的常规,投影规则明确固定的.
条款-最后词语仍然是弱点(20.5%的WER相对于14.6%的oracle)。 一旦有大约40个经过编辑的组合,投影和重播一起使遗留层成为一个零标签的适应信号,价值约为甲骨文缺口的三分之一。

blocks.en:
For the untranscribed block fol. 204–287, no true error rate can be computed, so we report edition agreement . Two cross-fitted R2L-BPE hybrids, each trained on half of the 394 transcribed sides, read the other half and the block; each read line is searched in all nineteenth-century texts, and the CER of the covered lines (distance ≤ \leq 0.30, ≥ \geq 25 characters) against the edition is measured. On the development and test pages of fol. 1–203 it covers 51% of the lines, and for 1,475 covered lines with a modern target agreement CER is 7.44% and true CER 4.87%: a bias of − - 2.6 points (95% CI − - 3.4 to − - 1.9), stable in aggregate although the line-level correlation is weak ( r = 0.17 r=0.17 ). On the block, 48% of the lines are covered, with 10.37% agreement CER (10.00–10.79%), and the calibrated estimate is 7.80% CER against 4.87% on the transcribed pages. The edition mix of the covered block lines matches that of the calibration pages (Horoy 85% against 84%), agreement CER is higher on the block within each edition family (Horoy 9.8% against 7.1%), and calibrating each family separately gives 7.64% (95% CI 6.68–8.52%); the bias does not differ between the two transcribed years ( − - 0.7 points, 95% CI − - 2.5 to + + 1.1). A change-point analysis of all 562 sides (the line embeddings of an encoder trained only on Innocent III’s registers, an orthographic fingerprint of the readings, and the corrected agreement) finds no change of hand inside the block: its only visual boundary lies before fol. 191r (bootstrap support 88%), so the block continues the hand of fol. 191–203.
Edition agreement therefore gives an aggregate quality estimate for unseen folios at no annotation cost, and the block is genuinely harder to read than the years used for training, not merely covered by noisier editions.
blocks.zh:
204–287, 无法计算出真正的错误率, 所以我们报告版本协议。 两个交叉配音的R2L-BPE混合音,每组在394个转写边的一半上训练,读出另一半和块;每个读行在所有19世纪的文本中被搜索,并比照版本测量覆盖线的CER(距离\\leq 0.30,\\ geq 25字符). 关于fol的开发和测试页面. 1–203覆盖了51%的线路,1,475条有现代目标协议的覆盖线路的CER为7.44%,真实的CER为4.87%:偏差为--2.6分(95% CI−3.4至−1.9),虽然线级关联性弱(r=0.17 r=0.17),但总体稳定。 在区块上,覆盖了48%的线路,10.37%的协议CER(10.00至10.79%),校准的估计为-7.80% CER,而在转录页上为4.87%。 覆盖区块线的版面组合与校准页(Horoy 85%对84%)相匹配,每个版块内部的协议CER更高(Horoy 9.8%对7.1%),每个版块的校准分别给出7.64%(95% CI 6.68–8.52%);两个转录年份之间的偏差并不不同(−-0.7分,95% CI–−-2.5–+ 1.1)。 对562个方位的变换点分析(只经过Innocent III注册的编码器的线根嵌入,读数的正字指纹,以及校正的协议)发现区块内部没有改变手势:其唯一的视觉边界位于fol之前. 191r(bootstrap支持88%),因此块延续了fol的手. 191–203 (英语).
因此,编辑协议在没有注解费用的情况下,对隐形框进行了总体质量估计,而且与培训所用的年份相比,该区块确实更难阅读,而不仅仅是由新手版覆盖。

blocks.en: 6 Pressutti as an Entry Segmenter
blocks.zh: 6 将 Pressuti 作为条目分隔符

blocks.en: Table 7: Experiment 5: entry start lines on the 394 transcribed sides of Reg. Vat. 9 (758 starts found in the reading), read by the cross-fitted hybrids; gold starts from the (audited) expert transcription, used for evaluation only. Date anchor: a line that reads the Roman date of a regest ends that letter.
blocks.zh: 表7:实验5:在Reg. Vat 9的394转写侧的输入起始线(758开头在读本中发现),由交叉调配的杂交体读取;黄金从(审计)专家转写开始,仅用于评价. 日期主播:一行读取罗马日期的记事符结束该字母.

blocks.en: Where no edition exists, the recognizer’s output is an undivided stream of lines, and Pressutti’s folio, address, and incipit are its only external structure. We test Pressutti as an entry segmenter on all 394 sides, read by the cross-fitted hybrids (no page is read by a model that saw it). Gold starts are the lines holding the first 40 characters of each expert entry (758, 312 without nineteenth-century text). The prediction uses Pressutti only: each of the 970 regests of books 1–2 is searched on the sides of its folio, ± \pm 1 (109 missing folio numbers are imputed from neighboring regests and searched ± \pm 2), and a start is placed at the line matching its address, or before the line matching its incipit. A baseline without Pressutti places a start after every line with a datum clause.
blocks.zh: 在没有版本的地方,识别器的输出是一条不分割的线条流,而Pressutti的folio,地址和incipit是其唯一的外部结构. 我们把Pressutti测试为所有394边的条目分割器,由交叉调配的混合体读取(没有一页读取的是看到它的模型). Gold start是每个专家条目(758,312没有十九世纪文本)的前40个字符的手持行. 预测只使用 Pressutti : 书卷 1–2 的 970 条记录中的每一条被搜索到其书卷的两侧, ±\pm 1(109 缺失的书卷数字从邻居的书卷中推算出来并搜索 ±\pm 2), 并在匹配其地址的线条或匹配其内存的线条之前放置一个开始. 没有Pressuti的基线在每一行之后都加上一个基准条款。

blocks.en: Pressutti alone finds 36.3% of the starts within one line, at 60.2% precision (Table 7 ), fewer than the datum baseline (55.4% recall), because a quarter of the transcribed entries cannot be matched to a parsed regest and short incipits are ambiguous. Yet the two signals are complementary: combining both finds 68.7% of the starts ( F 1 F_{1} 63.7%, against 58.5% for the baseline). Pressutti’s recall is only slightly lower on entries without an edition (34.3% against 37.7%), so it carries over to the unedited register.
blocks.zh: 仅Pressutti就发现36.3%的起始点在一条线内,精度为60.2%(表7),低于基准量(55.4%),因为四分之一的转录条目无法匹配解析的正则和短的肠腔模糊不清. 然而这两个信号是互补的:两者合在一起发现68.7%的起始数(F 1 F_{1}63.7%,基线为58.5%)。 Pressutti的召回在没有版本的条目上只是略微低一些(34.3%对37.7%),所以转录到未经编辑的登记册上。

blocks.en: The register orders the entries of each book by letter number, so the regests can also be aligned to the line stream as a sequence. Gaps in the parsed letter numbers become placeholder slots (824 of 1,794); each slot–line pair is scored by a closing formula on the previous line and the address and incipit matches (weights and threshold chosen on the training sides), and the best monotone assignment is decoded by dynamic programming. On all 394 sides, the base of Table 7 , it reaches F 1 F_{1} 54.9% within one line (exact line 40.6%), against 58.5% (35.0%) for the closing formula alone; on the 153 starts of the development and test sides only, which played no part in choosing the weights, the two reach 56.5% (39.9%) and 58.5% (33.1%). The sequence constraint does not add recall, which locates the bottleneck in matching regests to lines rather than in their order. The OCR of the regest strings matters little: replacing them by the expert’s own address and incipit raises the union recall only to 68.5%.
blocks.zh: 寄存器按字母编号命令每本书的条目,因此,记录器也可以与行流对齐作为序列. 解析字母号中的空隙成为占位符位(1,794个中的824个);每个插槽-线对在前一行的关闭公式以及地址和incipit匹配(训练方选择的重量和阈值)中得分,最好的单调任务通过动态编程解码. 在所有394个方面,表7的基数在一行内(确切的线路为40.6%)达到F 1 F_{1}54.9%,而仅关闭公式就达到58.5%(35.0%);在153个开发和试验方的起始点上(在选择权重方面没有发挥作用),两者分别达到56.5%(39.9%)和58.5%(33.1%)。 序列约束不添加召回,它定位了在匹配Regests与线条而不是顺序上的瓶颈. 注册商的OCR并不重要:用专家自己的地址来取代,

blocks.en: Pressutti dates each regest in modern form; converted to the chancery’s Roman form (Kalends, Nones, Ides, pridie , the bissextile day, the regnal year from 24 July), the dates of 877 of the 970 regests of books 1–2 agree with Pressutti’s own Roman date in 89% of the 779 cases where he prints it, and 357 are found in the recognized lines. A line that reads the date of a regest closes that letter, so the next line starts an entry. Added to the union, this anchor finds 73.9% of the starts ( F 1 F_{1} 65.6%, 95% CI 62.5–68.5; recall + + 5.1 points, CI + + 3.5 to + + 6.9), and 73.4% on entries without an edition (Table 7 ). In the monotone DP the training sides give the date no weight, and a soft ut supra constraint (an identical date may be written Dat. ut supra ) changes nothing ( F 1 F_{1} 54.9%). The remaining misses are regests that the parser does not reach (73), folios that are missing or off by more than one (56), and regests found but placed on another line (67); a misread date accounts for 2. The chancery’s own dates, not better OCR of the regests, are the lever for regest-driven segmentation.
blocks.zh: Pressutti 日期以现代形式出现; 转换为总理府的罗马形式(Kalends, Nones, Ides, Pridie, bisextile day, regnal year from 24 ) , 970年第1–2册的Regest中的877个日期与Pressutti 自己的罗马日期一致,在他打印的779个案件中有89%与357个在公认的行中找到。 一条读出一个注册日期的行会关闭该字母,所以下一行开始一个条目. 除了工会之外,该主播还发现73.9%的起播(F 1 F% 1 } 65.6%,95% CI 62.5–68.5;召回++5.1分,CI++3.5至+6.9),73.4%的条目没有版本(表7). 在单调的DP中,训练方不给这个日期任何权重,一个软调的上方约束(上面的Dat. ut可以写一个相同的日期)不会改变任何东西(F 1 F_{1}54.9%)。 其余的缺失是解析器没有到达的记录(73),丢失或关闭超过一个(56)的薄膜,以及发现但放在另一行(67)上的记录;误读日期为2。 总统府自己的日期, 而不是更适合监管者的OCR,

blocks.en: 7 Legacy Vocabulary and Neural NER
blocks.zh: 7 遗存词汇和神经NER

blocks.en: Table 8: Rescoring of the 16-best lists of the R2L hybrid with NER head trained on re-aligned lines (39 test pages). Names: WER on name words; sigla: WER against the reference with name initials as written, on all test lines; sigla, 31: the same on the 31 lines where the initials convention changes the reference. Top: joint score alone and with the folio gazetteer (with a 5-best list the same model has 10.5% WER). Bottom: the baseline language models, the leak-free legacy layer, and OOV post-correction.
blocks.zh: 表8 重评R2L混血儿的16个最佳名单,NER头部接受过重联线培训(39个测试页). 名称 : WER on name words; sigla: WER 与引用相对应,名称首字母为书面,在所有测试线上; Sigla, 31:在31行中相同,其中首字母常规更改引用. Top:单独和与folio地名录(拥有5个最佳名单,同一模式的WER有10.5%)共同得分. 底部:基线语言模型,无漏遗迹层,OOV后修正.

blocks.en: A gazetteer of the capitalized words of Pressutti’s regests for each folio and its neighbors, rewarded in the rescoring of the 16-best lists of the NER hybrid ( λ = 0.4 \lambda=0.4 on the development lines), changes the name WER from 29.9% to 29.5% and leaves the WER at 10.8% (Table 8 ). Two causes limit it. The attention beam collapses on names: 70.1% of the 441 name words of the test lines are correct in the best hypothesis and 78.2% in at least one of the 16, so for 73% of the misread names no hypothesis offers the right form; larger lists help only slowly (oracle name WER 21.8% at 16 and 16.1% at 128 hypotheses, with 54% of the misread names still absent), and the CTC prefix beam levels off at 19.7%. The regests also name only the principal persons (113 of the name words are in the folio gazetteer, 139 with all capitalized regest words and their case forms). Contextual biasing inside CTC prefix beam search, where the beam does not collapse, therefore does not help either: the name WER is 29.7% without and 29.7% with the folio gazetteer, and with the leak-free entities of the whole legacy layer it stays between 29.5% and 30.4% in all 10 settings of bias weight and beam width. Regest summaries are too sparse to steer decoding; the useful lexical evidence lies in the full texts.
blocks.zh: 将WER从29.9%改为29.5%, 将WER留为10.8%(表8)。 二因缘所限. 注意光束在名字上崩溃:试验线441个名字词中有70.1%在最佳假说中正确,至少16个名字中有1个正确,78.2%,因此对于73%的误读名字来说,没有假说提供正确的形式;较大的列表只会缓慢帮助(甲状腺素名称WER21.8%在16,16.1%在128个假说中,54%的误读名字仍然缺失),CTC前缀光束值为19.7%。 登记员还只列出主要人物的名字(其中113个名字在地名词典中,139个名字带有所有资本化的登记词及其案例表)。 在CTC前缀光束搜索中进行背景偏差,光束不会坍塌,因此也无济于事:WER这个名字是29.7%没有,29.7%用folio地名录,而整个遗留层的无漏实体在所有10个偏差重量和光束宽度的场合中,都停留在29.5%至30.4%之间. 记录摘要太少,无法进行解码;有用的词汇证据在于全文。

blocks.en: Table 9: Coverage of test words by the legacy lexicon (all words of the 5,059 regests and the eleven edition volumes after curial projection; 5,056,092 words, 408,329 types; entity: stems of the words tagged as persons or places by the RoBERTa charter tagger or the Span-NER model in these texts). Training-OOV: words of the 39 test pages that are not in the training vocabulary; names: name words of the gold benchmark of Table 10 . Editions may print the entries in which a word occurs; the rows without edition are the relevant ones for unedited folios.
blocks.zh: 表9:按遗留词汇(5,059份登记表的所有字和图案投影后的11卷;5,056,092个字,408,329种;实体:这些文本中被RoBERTa特许标记器或Span-NER模型标注为人或地点的字的源头)对测试词的涵盖。 培训-OOV:没有在培训词汇中的39个测试页的单词; 名称:表10金基准的名称单词. 编辑可以打印一个字发生的条目;没有编辑的行是未经编辑的缩写的相关行.

blocks.en: The full legacy layer of all regests and all eleven volumes (5,056,092 words, 408,329 types after projection, OCR forms included) covers far more. Of the training-OOV words in test entries that no edition prints, 82.2% occur in it in exactly the same form (93.5% by stem), and of the names 84.5% (90.1% among the stems of the 85,688 entity types that either tagger finds in it; Table 9 ). It is too permissive to choose between hypotheses (69.1% of the wrong words of C with language-model fusion occur in it, against 98.7% of its correct ones). Conversely, absence from the legacy lexicon provides a strong diagnostic signal: with the leak-free lexicon of the next paragraph, a word outside it is wrong with 66.7% precision, and this flag catches 30.9% of the 1,121 wrong words while marking 3.7% of all words. Combined with the calibrated word posterior of the hybrid (error probability ≥ \geq 0.3), it sends 1.2% of the words to review at 93.0% precision (14.4% recall); the posterior alone ( ≥ \geq 0.2) catches 58.2% of the errors when 9.6% of the words are routed.
blocks.zh: 所有登记簿和所有11卷(5 056 092字,投影后408 329种,包括OCR表格)的完整遗产层覆盖的要远得多。 在测试条目中没有版面打印的训练-OOV词中,82.2%以完全相同的形式出现(93.5%按干),84.5%的名称(在标记者发现的85 688个实体类型中,90.1%)。 在假设中作出选择是太放任自流的(其中69.1%为带有语言模式聚变的C错误词,而98.7%为正确词)。 反之,遗留的词典的缺失提供了一个强烈的诊断信号:随着下段的无漏词典,其外的一个词精度为66.7%是错误的,这面旗帜捕捉到1,121个错误词的30.9%,同时标记所有词的3.7%。 它与混合体的校准词后缀(error possible ≥\geq 0.3)相结合,将1.2%的单词以93.0%的精度(14.4%)发回;单词后缀(≥\\geq 0.2)在9.6%的单词被路由时就捕捉到58.2%的错误.

blocks.en: For decoding we rebuild the legacy layer without the edition spans of all entries on development and test pages (140 spans), so that no edition of a held-out letter enters the models; 4,782,222 words remain for a BPE 4-gram and a word trigram model. (a) In the 16-best rescoring, these models, the shares of words in the legacy lexicon and of capitalized words among its entities, and the folio gazetteer join the baseline language models (weights on the development rows: legacy BPE 0.1, lexicon 0.05, entities 0.05, gazetteer 0.2). (b) A word outside the training vocabulary whose calibrated error probability (from its posterior in the 16-best list) is ≥ \geq 0.2 is replaced by a legacy word or entity within edit distance 2 if the hybrid’s CTC head scores the changed line at most 0.0 nats lower. On the test pages (Table 8 ), the WER falls from 10.0% to 9.9% with (a) and to 9.8% with (b), and the OOV WER from 21.9% to 21.6%, while the name WER moves from 27.2% to 27.4% (99 words changed); on the lines of unedited entries, the OOV WER falls from 18.3% to 17.8%. Post-correction acts on few words (of 123 changed words, 18 become correct and 8 wrong). The total change of − - 0.16 WER points (95% CI − - 0.33 to + + 0.03; page bootstrap; p = 0.052 p{=}0.052 ) is small and, on the audited system, not distinguishable from zero; the name WER does not improve, which positions the legacy lexicon as a signal for review rather than for decoding.
blocks.zh: 为了解码,我们重建了遗留层,没有所有开发与测试页面的版本跨度(140个跨度),因此没有被搁置信件的版本进入模型;4,782,222个单词仍然保留在BPE 4克和一个单词三重模型上. (a) 在16个最佳重评中,这些模型、其实体在遗留词典中的字数份额和资本字份额,以及folio地名录加入基线语言模型(开发行的加权数:遗留的BPE 0.1、Lexicon 0.05、initual 0.05、Lexter 0.2)。 (b) 训练词汇之外的一个词,如果混合体的CTC头在最多0.0纳特以下时,其校准误差概率(从其16个最佳名单中的后缀)为\geq 0.2,则在编辑距离2的范围内用遗留词或实体取代。 在试验页(表8)上,WER从10.0%下降到9.9%,其中(a)和(b)为9.8%,而OOV WER从21.9%下降到21.6%,而WER的名称从27.2%下降到27.4%(99个字更改);在未经编辑的条目中,OOV WER从18.3%下降到17.8%。 更正后对少数字的行为(123个变更字中,18个变为正确,8个错误). − -0.16 WER点的总变化(95% CI - - - 0.33 到 + + 0.03; p = 0.052 p - 0.052)是很小的,在被审计的系统上,WER不与零区分;名称不改进,将遗留的词典定位为审查而不是解码的信号.

blocks.en: Table 10: Name words (persons and places) on the 39 test pages against the gold benchmark (692 name words, adjudicated and checked by an expert). Rows (b) and (c) on the reference contribute to the benchmark and are not independent of it. WER: recognition WER of the model; heads are evaluated on their own recognized text, mapped to the reference words. CI: page bootstrap of F 1 F_{1} (10,000 resamples).
blocks.zh: 表10:对照黄金基准的39个测试页(692个名称单词,由一名专家裁定和检查)上的名称(人和地点)。 参考文献中的(b)和(c)行有助于基准,而不独立于基准。 WER:模型的识别WER;头部根据自己公认的文字进行评估,映射到参考词. CI:F 1 FQQQ1}的页带(10,000个复标).

blocks.en: The NER head of Kovács and Luger (2026) was trained on labels from a heuristic rule (capitalized, not a Collatinus form, not a title). We replace the rule with two pre-trained models for medieval charters: the RoBERTa tagger of Torres Aguilar (2022) (persons, places) and the bi-encoder Span-NER of Kovács et al. (2026) (19 labels, of which we use persons and places). On the test references the two agree on 98.1% of the words (Cohen’s κ = 0.73 \kappa=0.73 for name versus non-name). Their 349 disagreements are first decided by explicit philological and documentary rules (lower case in the expert text, -ensis adjectives, offices and calendar terms, saints and feasts, ethnonyms, the folio’s Pressutti regests, person or place context, abbreviations, Collatinus forms), and an expert then checked every disagreement (349 words) and a random sample of 50 of the 414 words both models tag and 50 of the 370 capitalized words both leave untagged, changing 40 labels. Agreement is not truth: none of the sampled agreed names was wrong, but 24% of the agreed capitalized non-names were names (95% CI 12–36%), 11% over both agreement strata. The validated labels form the gold benchmark (692 name words). Against it (Table 10 ) the heuristic rule reaches F 1 F_{1} 68.5%, and both models lose recall when applied post hoc to recognized text (RoBERTa 79.3% on the reference and 66.9% on recognized text, Span-NER 92.2% and 81.7%). Distilling the ensemble labels into the recognizer’s own NER head raises its F 1 F_{1} from 60.0% with rule labels to 82.1% ( + + 22.1 points, 95% CI + + 18.0 to + + 27.4; paired page bootstrap) at a WER of 11.1% against 11.0%; RoBERTa labels alone give 70.7%. The distilled head is ahead of the RoBERTa tagger run post hoc on the same recognized text ( + + 15.2 points, CI + + 11.6 to + + 18.9) and level with the Span-NER model run post hoc ( + + 0.4, CI − - 2.4 to + + 3.4), while adding only a linear layer to decoding. Labels from the legacy layer (Pressutti names and legacy entities in the training lines) do not improve on the ensemble labels (80.2% together) and alone reach 66.0% (rule labels: 60.0%). Pre-trained medieval NER thus supplies entity supervision that a hand-written rule cannot, and the recognizer’s head absorbs it at no cost in reading accuracy.
blocks.zh: Kovács和Luger的NER头目(2026年)接受过来自heuristic规则(资本化,不是Collatinus形式,不是标题)的标签培训. 我们用两个经过预先训练的中世纪特许状的模型来取代这个规则:托雷斯·阿吉拉尔的RoBERTa标记器(2022年)(人物,地点)和科瓦茨等人的双编码器Span-NER(2026年)(19个标签,我们使用人物和地点). 在测试参考中,两人同意98.1%的单词(Cohen's ob = 0.73\kappa= 0.73 for name to un-name). 他们的349项分歧首先通过明确的哲学和文献规则(专家文本中的较轻的案例、形容词、办公室和日历术语、圣人和宴会、民族名词、folio's Pressutti regests、人或地点背景、缩写、Collatinus表格)来决定,然后一名专家检查了每一项分歧(349字),并随机抽取了414个字中的50个字和370个资本字中的50个字。 协议不是事实:抽样的商定名称都没有错,但24%的商定资本化的非名称是名称(95%的CI 12-36 %),在两个协议级别上都是11%。 经验证的标签构成黄金基准(692个名称单词). 反之(表10),热力学规则达到F 1 FQQQ1}68.5%,两种模型在临时适用于公认文本时都失去了记忆(参考版为RoBERTa 79.3%,公认文本66.9%,Span-NER92.2%和81.7%)。 将组合标签分解到识别器自身的NER头部,其F 1 FQQQ1}将规则标签从60.0%提升至82.1%(+22.1分,95% CI+18.0至+27.4分;配对的页带)在WER比为11.1%;仅RoBERTa标签就给出了70.7%。 蒸馏头位于RoBERTa标记器前方,在同一公认文本(++15.2分,CI+11.6至+++18.9)上运行后临时,用Span-NER模型进行后临时运行(++0.4,CI−−−2.4至+3.4),同时只添加一个线性层进行解码. 遗留层的标签(Pressutti names和遗留实体在训练线上)在综艺标签上没有改善(共80.2%),仅此一项就达到了66.0%(规则标签:60.0%)。 因此,经过预先培训的中世纪NER提供实体监督,即手写规则不能做到,而识别者头部在阅读准确性方面不惜任何代价吸收它.

blocks.en: The register often names persons by an initial ( B. electo ). A standoff layer proposes the full name without altering the recognized text: candidates come from the parenthesized expansions and names of the entry’s regest and from its linked edition, ranked by initial, person context (a following title or office), and the words shared with the line around the initial. Where the register writes a person’s name in full and the recognizer reads it, masking the name to its initial and resolving it gives a candidate for 70% of the 66 names, and the first candidate is the written form for 13 of these 46 (28%, 95% Wilson CI 17–43%; 36% when the entry is known). On the transcribed sides, 52% of the 607 sigla in the recognized lines receive a candidate, and on fol. 204–287 83% of 454, with several candidates for 64%. The layer is therefore a candidate list for expert review, not an automatic resolution.
blocks.zh: 登记册经常以初始(B. electo)命名。 一个对峙层提出全名而不修改公认文本:候选人来自括号中的扩展和条目注册名称及其链接版本,按初始的人物背景排列(标题或职位之后),以及与条目首页前后的行共用的词句. 登记簿上写满一个人的名字,而识别者读到这个名字,将名字遮盖到名字的初始位置并解析出来,就为66个名字中的70%提供了候选人,而第一个候选人是这46个名字中的13个(28%,95% Wilson CI 17–43 %;已知条目时为36%)的书面表格。 在转写方面,在公认线的607 sigla中,有52%获得一名候选人,而在454中,有204-287 83%获得一名候选人,64%获得几名候选人。 因此,该层是专家审查的候选名单,而不是自动解决。

blocks.en: 8 Discussion
blocks.zh: 8 讨论情况

blocks.en: Nineteenth-century scholarship and HTR divide the work across three tiers. At the orthographic tier (RQ1), forced alignment places legacy text correctly, and curial projection removes the editorial spelling of the classicizing editions: raw editions are at best neutral for an adapted recognizer and harmful without replay, whereas projection and replay of modern source lines turn the same editions into zero-label adaptation targets ( − - 1.50 WER points pooled over all year-2 sides, 33% of the oracle gap, given some forty edited folios). The year-2 experiment measures a change of spelling at the year split, attributable to the scribe or the transcriber, and a change of hand only on fol. 191–203 (the visual boundary lies at fol. 191r); the gain for a different scribe remains to be confirmed on the later registers. Legacy text cannot replace modern transcription as primary training data (20.1% against 14.5% WER with as many modern lines), but it can audit it: where the projected edition and an independent reading agree against the transcription, 88% of the decidable corrections in a judged sample hold. At the lexical tier (RQ2), the corpus-wide legacy lexicon covers 82.2% of the OOV words of unedited entries and identifies recognition errors with 66.7% precision, enough to send 1.2% of the words to review at 93.0% precision; pre-trained medieval NER models, distilled into the recognizer’s head, match the best post-hoc tagger on an expert-validated benchmark (82.1% against 81.7% F 1 F_{1} ), and the regests propose expansions for initials as a review layer. At the topological tier (RQ3), where full texts are absent, Pressutti’s regests, the closing datum clauses, and the chancery’s Roman dates segment the recognized line stream into entries (73.9% of starts; the misses lie in regest parsing and folio reconciliation, not in the OCR of the regests), and edition agreement calibrates aggregate recognition error beyond the transcribed folios (7.80% estimated CER). For the later registers this suggests a workflow: train on modern transcriptions, adapt to each new register with projected legacy lines, route flagged words to expert review, and cut the output into entries with the regesta and their dates.
blocks.zh: 19世纪的奖学金和HTR将工作分为三个层次. 在正文级(RQ1),强制对齐将遗留文本正确放置,曲切投影删除了经典版的编辑拼写:原始版最多对一个经过调整的识别器是中性的,并且有害而不重播,而现代源线的投影和重播则将同一版变为零标签的适应目标(− - 1.50 WER点集在全年-2的方位,占甲骨文缺口的33%,因为有约40个经过编辑的音符). 年-2实验测量的是年分时的拼写变化,可归结于文士或转写,只用fol换手. 191–203(视界位于fol.191r);不同文员的收益尚待以后的登记册确认。 遗产文本不能取代现代的抄录数据作为初级培训数据(20.1%对14.5%的WER有尽可能多的现代行),但它可以审计:如果预测版和独立阅读与抄录一致,88%的可裁定更正在判断的样本持有量中. 在语法层面(RQ2),全元遗留语法覆盖了未经编辑条目的OOV词的82.2%,并且以66.7%的精度识别识别错误,足以将1.2%的词发送到93.0%的精度审查;预训的中世纪NER模型,蒸馏到识别器头部,匹配专家认证基准(82.1%对81.7%的F 1FQQ1})上的最佳后标记器,而记录器则建议扩展首字母作为审查层。 在没有全文的地貌层面(RQ3),Pressutti的登记表、最后基准条款和公会的罗马日期将公认的线条流分解为条目(73.9%的起始点;缺失之处在于记录解析和比对,而不是记录的OCR),以及版本协议校准了转录线条以外的总识别错误(7.80%的估计CER )。 对于以后的登记册来说,这意味着一个工作流程:就现代的抄本进行培训,用预测的遗留线来适应每个新的登记册,用标明路线的文字进行专家审查,并将产出与Regesta及其日期一起切成条目。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
All measurements come from one register volume. The year-2 test set has 13 pages, and the transfer gain varies by about a point across training seeds; the cross-validated estimate over all 134 year-2 sides is half the 13-page gain, and its folds adapt on only two-thirds of the legacy lines. The nineteenth-century texts cover about half of the transcribed entries, and their coverage beyond fol. 203 is not known in advance. Linking and alignment depend on the OCR of the Internet Archive scans, which we did not correct. The NER gold benchmark starts from two pre-trained models: the expert checked every disagreement but only samples of the agreements, so the unchecked agreed words keep an estimated error of 11%, concentrated in capitalized words that both models leave untagged; its conventions (saints, feasts, and ethnonyms are not entities) are choices that another annotator might set differently, and the legacy lexicon includes the OCR errors of its sources.
The year-1/year-2 split confounds hand and transcriber. The change-point analysis places the visual change of hand before fol. 191r, inside year 2, whereas the spelling of the readings changes at the year split; the transfer experiment therefore measures a change of spelling, attributable to the scribe or to the transcriber, and a change of hand only for fol. 191–203. Split by segment, the cross-validated gain of the legacy lines is the same on both (Section 5), so it does not depend on the change of hand. The encoder embeddings are trained for recognition, not writer identification, so two scribes of the same chancery school may be visually indistinguishable to them. These boundaries are statistical and await a palaeographic check.
blocks.zh:
所有测量都来自一个记录卷。 年-2测试集有13页,转会收益在训练种子之间大约各有一点不同;所有134年-2的交叉验证估计值是13页增益的一半,其折叠只适应遗产线的三分之二. 十九世纪的文本覆盖了大约一半的转录条目,其覆盖范围超出了fol. 203是事先不知道的。 链接和对齐取决于互联网档案馆扫描的OCR,我们没有纠正. NER黄金基准从两个预先训练过的模型开始:专家检查了所有分歧,但只检查了协议的样本,因此不加限制的商定词保留了11%的估计错误,集中在两个模型未加标记的资本化词上;它的常规(油漆、宴会和民族名词不是实体)是另一个注释者可能不同的选择,而遗留的词汇包括其来源的OCR错误。
第1年/第2年的分裂使手和转写曲折. 变点分析将手的视觉变化置于fol之前. 191r,在第二年之内,而读数的拼写在一年分时变化;因此,转写实验测量的是拼写变化,可归因于文士或转写,而换手只用于fol. 191–203 (英语). 按片段划分,遗产线的交叉验证收益在两者上都是相同的(第5节),因此不取决于换手. 编码器嵌入器被训练为识别,而不是编剧身份,所以同一门类学校的两位文士可能对他们视而不见. 这些边界是统计性的,等待古迹检查。
